---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What's the current limitation?

## Proposed Solution
How would you like this feature to work? Describe your ideal implementation.

## Use Cases
Describe specific use cases where this feature would be helpful:
- Use case 1: ...
- Use case 2: ...
- Use case 3: ...

## Alternatives Considered
Are there other ways to solve this problem? What are the trade-offs?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples:
- Links to similar features in other projects
- Mockups or wireframes
- Relevant documentation or references

## Implementation Ideas
If you have technical ideas on how this could be implemented, share them here:

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Blocking / Critical

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues and didn't find a duplicate
- [ ] This aligns with StarryCrypt's mission (client-side encryption)
- [ ] This doesn't compromise security or privacy
- [ ] I'm open to discussion and alternative approaches
